description: Check how many ERC-20 tokens a spender is approved to transfer. Returns the allowance in both raw and human-readable format. Use this to check if an approval is needed before a DeFi transaction.

decimals.description: Token decimals. Resolved from the registry or the token contract when omitted; if given, it must match

wallet_id.description: Wallet ID (used to determine the owner address)

name: get_allowance
